# GitOutbox Community Discussions

Welcome to GitOutbox Discussions! This is the place to connect with other developers, share configurations, ask usage questions, and propose ideas.

## Categories

Please choose the appropriate category for your discussion thread:
* **🙏 Q&A / Support**: Need help setting up templates, scheduling, or configuring recovery policies? Ask your questions here!
* **💡 Ideas / Suggestions**: Share features or enhancements you would love to see in future versions.
* **🙌 Show and Tell**: Show off your template layouts, custom CLI wrappers, or scheduling configurations.
* **💬 General**: Anything else related to GitOutbox that doesn't fit into the other categories.

Before posting, please review our [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](file:///c:/Projects/Gitlater/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
